# CBINNOV INC

> CBINNOV INC — Research & Development. Engineering-driven brands and high-quality products from Montréal, Québec, Canada. / Recherche et Développement : marques et produits de haute qualité conçus par des ingénieurs à Montréal.

Site: https://cbinnov.com/ (EN/FR, one page). Phone: +1 866-211-8441. Founded in 2020 in Montréal, Québec, Canada, by a group of engineers who couldn't find the product they expected on the market, so they designed and built it themselves.

## Brands / Marques
- [40Celsius](https://40celsius.ca): Canadian-built outdoor gear — 100% cotton prospector tents, wood stoves and equipment engineered for camping, hunting and glamping in any weather. / Équipement de plein air fabriqué au Canada : tentes prospecteur en coton, poêles à bois, équipement de camping et de chasse.
- [Kanartic](https://kanartic.ca): DIY mini-split heat pumps engineered for Canadian winters — efficient down to −30 °C, high-SEER, self-installation without special tools. / Thermopompes mini-split à installer soi-même, conçues pour l'hiver canadien.
- [Tornado](https://tornado.40celsius.ca): Cyclonic tabletop wood fire pit — 360° radiant heat, rotating vortex flame, no fan required, stainless steel. / Foyer de table à bois à flamme cyclonique, sans ventilateur.
- [ZERO HVAC Canada](https://zerohvac.ca): The Canadian home of ZERO cold-climate mini-splits and multi-zone systems — rebates, design temperatures and recommended models for every province, bilingual. / Vitrine canadienne des thermopompes ZERO, bilingue, avec subventions et modèles recommandés par province.

## Values / Valeurs
- Engineering-first: every product starts from a real need and a measured problem.
- Quality & efficiency: built to perform and last.
- Made for everyone: priced and designed so that anyone can use it.

## Related / Liés
- [Altea Communications](https://altea.ca): network, security and access-control integrator of the same group (Saint-Eustache, Québec).
